_meta.purpose: Boss → entrance-animation classification. Tracks which scripted intro a chr plays on encounter activation. Used to prevent CTDs from anim/geometry mismatch — e.g., emerge-from-ground intro at an elevated platform with no subsurface terrain.

values.emerge_from_ground: Chr rises out of the earth on encounter trigger. Fails at slots without subsurface terrain (rooftops, ramparts, platforms).
values.fly_in: Chr flies in from offscreen on encounter trigger. Requires sky access — fails in low-ceilinged interiors.
values.scripted_intro: Chr plays a slot-specific scripted intro (cinematic, position-locked). Tends to fail at non-vanilla arenas due to choreography mismatch.
values.pre_placed: Chr is positioned at encounter start, no scripted intro animation. Generally safe at unusual arenas.
values.walk_in: Chr walks into the arena from a fixed path. Less position-sensitive than scripted_intro but can fail if path is blocked.
values.unknown: Not yet classified. Default. No gate applied — chr placement proceeds as normal.

_meta.provenance: Manual seed from empirical CTD reports (v0.24.79–v0.24.80). Major expansion v0.24.82 via .behbnd behavior-template analysis: 19 new chrs added that share the EXACT same behavior tree (byte-identical modulo chr_id substring) as the confirmed emerge seeds c4441/c4442/c4480/c4481/c4482/c4483. The shared template hash is c880d10143 (size 11,124 bytes) — every chr using this template has the same AI state machine, same initial state, same scripted-reveal animation trigger. The visual intro may differ (slug crawling out of soil vs Miranda rising from pod) but the FAILURE MODE at no-emerge slots is identical because the underlying AI logic is identical. v0.24.83: Added c3730 Graven School based on empirical CTD report + refined signature (template c880d10143 ∩ has anim 9000) — discovered after extending behbnd corpus to 459 files (c0xxx-c9xxx). The template alone is NOT sufficient: 112 chrs use it, but 35 lack anim 9000 (System objects, Crabs, Training Posts, Lightning Ball) and are demonstrably not emerge. The refined intersection (template AND anim 9000) yields 50 candidates. c3730 is one of them and is the strongest candidate for the user's CTD report. v0.24.84: User correction — Giant Crabs DO emerge from earth (despite lacking anim 9000). This invalidates the v0.24.83 'refined signature' that filtered out chrs without anim 9000. Template c880d10143 membership IS the emerge signature for placeable chrs; the 35 'no anim 9000' template members are either non-placeable (System/Training Posts/Lightning Ball) or use non-standard intro animations (Crabs, possibly Octopus/UTS/Abductor Virgin). v0.24.84: c2270-c2277 Crab family added (8 entries). The 'refined signature' analysis in research notes superseded.

tae_and_behbnd_analysis_findings.anim_id_signature_failed: Animation ID 9000 is too generic (73% of chrs have it). No anim ID is a discriminative signature at corpus scale.
tae_and_behbnd_analysis_findings.behavior_template_signature_succeeded: Chr-id-normalized hash of .behbnd's Behaviors/{cp}.hkx is the actual signature. Template c880d10143 = 25-chr emerge_from_ground cluster. Template cc910d90c1 (size 21,776) = c4810/c4811 Erdtree Avatar variant cluster.
tae_and_behbnd_analysis_findings.variant_inheritance: Animation data inherits via parent (c4441 inherits anims from c4440), but behavior trees do NOT inherit — each variant has its own behbnd. This is why behbnd analysis works as a classifier where anibnd analysis didn't.
tae_and_behbnd_analysis_findings.coverage: v0.24.82 classifications cover the c4xxx range (149 behbnds). Other ranges (c3xxx, c5xxx etc.) need their own behbnd dumps for full classification.
tae_and_behbnd_analysis_findings.refined_signature_v0_24_83: Behavior template c880d10143 membership is NECESSARY but not SUFFICIENT for emerge_from_ground. The full corpus (459 behbnds, c0xxx-c9xxx) reveals 112 template members — many are System objects (c0110-c0130, c1000, c9001), Crabs (c2270-c2277), Training Posts (c8130-c8132), and Lightning Ball (c2150) which are demonstrably not emerge. The refined signature requires BOTH template membership AND anim 9000 presence in the anibnd. This narrows to ~50 candidates. Empirical CTD confirmation expanded with c3730 Graven School.
tae_and_behbnd_analysis_findings.v0_24_84_correction: v0.24.83 over-corrected. User confirmed Giant Crabs emerge from earth despite lacking anim 9000 — they use a non-standard intro animation. Template c880d10143 membership IS the signature for placeable emerge chrs. The 35 'no anim 9000' template members fall into two groups: (1) non-placeable framework chrs (System objects c0110-c0130, c1000, c9001; Training Posts c8130-c8132; Lightning Ball c2150) which the rando doesn't shuffle anyway, and (2) genuine emerge chrs using non-standard intro animations (Crabs c2270-c2277, possibly Octopus c4220/c4230, UTS c4640, Abductor Virgin c4470). Therefore v0.24.82's 'false positives' weren't actually false — they were correct classifications based on template membership.

_meta.growth_pattern: Add chrs as new CTDs surface OR as behbnd-template evidence identifies new family members. Conservative — when in doubt, leave as 'unknown' (no gate).
